error.engineMessage: No external task found with id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000: externalTask is null
error.hint: The engine could not process the request; the engine message says why. Camunda 7 engines also report rule violations (task already claimed, dependent instances, ...) as 500, so retrying unchanged rarely helps.
